quote: A vehicle shall not be driven over any unprotected hose of a fire department when laid down on any highway or private way or place for use at any fire or alarm of fire or practice runs, without the consent of the fire department official in command.

activation.condition: A human driver drives an ordinary vehicle over an actual fire-department hose laid on the assigned private way for a qualifying fire, alarm or practice purpose.

obligation.description: Do not drive over the unprotected hose without consent of the fire department official in command.

exceptions.source_clause: without the consent of the fire department official in command
exceptions.trigger: source-established consent of that official, effective before physical passage and scoped to it
exceptions.effect: the stated without-consent condition is absent
exceptions.description: A gesture or stated scenario label alone is insufficient.

timing.description: Original consent interval relative to each original body-over-hose frame.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original protection arrangement and actual hose identity require review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: for use at any fire or alarm of fire or practice runs
judgment_calls_needed.note: Department purpose must be established by an original incident source.
Original command appointment and identity require review.
Communication source, scope, timing and authority require review.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: none, given or withheld by official in command

parameter_refs.name: planned_hose_crossing
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: crossing or avoidance route; actual body contact measured

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: one original C197786 private way and hose
